name: io.github.getsentry/mobilebuildmcp
description: MobileBuildMCP provides tools for Xcode project management, simulator management, and app utilities.

environmentVariables.name: INCREMENTAL_BUILDS_ENABLED
environmentVariables.description: Enable experimental xcodemake incremental builds (true/false or 1/0).

environmentVariables.name: MOBILEBUILDMCP_ENABLED_WORKFLOWS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated list of workflows to load at startup (e.g., 'simulator,device,project-discovery').

environmentVariables.name: MOBILEBUILDMCP_DEBUG
environmentVariables.description: Enable verbose debug logging from the server.
